case_title: State of Maharashtra v. Union of India & Ors.
party_caption: State of Maharashtra versus Union of India and Others
presiding_judge: Hon'ble Dr. Justice D.Y. Chandrachud, CJI
coram_members_text: Dr. D.Y. Chandrachud, C.J.I., P.S. Narasimha and J.B. Pardiwala, JJ.
disposition_text: Appeal Allowed. The impugned order of the High Court is set aside. Matter remanded back for fresh consideration.
indexable_text: CONSTITUTIONAL LAW - Federal Structure - Powers of Governor under Article 163 and 174 of Constitution of India. Floor test called without objective material vitiates exercise of constitutional discretion. Held, Governor cannot enter the political arena or precipitate the fall of a government without tangible material before him.
headnote_text: Constitution of India — Arts. 163, 174, 356 — Floor test — Discretion of Governor — Exercise of power without objective material: Governor does not have the authority in law to call for a floor test without objective material indicating loss of majority on the floor of the House.

case_title: TechServe Solutions Pvt. Ltd. v. Bharat Telecom Infrastructure Corp.
party_caption: TechServe Solutions Pvt. Ltd. versus Bharat Telecom Infrastructure Corp.
disposition_text: Petition Allowed. Sole Arbitrator appointed under Section 11(6) of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
indexable_text: ARBITRATION AND CONCILIATION ACT, 1996 - Section 11(6) - Appointment of sole arbitrator. Existence of valid arbitration clause not disputed. Unilateral appointment of arbitrator by respondent held invalid in terms of Perkins Eastman Architects DPC v. HSCC (India) Ltd. Court appoints independent former High Court judge as sole arbitrator.
headnote_text: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 — S. 11(6) — Unilateral appointment of sole arbitrator: Unilateral appointment violates S. 12(5) read with Seventh Schedule. Independent arbitrator appointed by High Court.

case_title: Rajesh Kumar Sharma v. State of Maharashtra & Anr.
party_caption: Rajesh Kumar Sharma versus State of Maharashtra and Another
disposition_text: Application Disposed of with directions. Regular bail granted subject to solvent surety and passport surrender.
indexable_text: CRIMINAL PROCEDURE CODE, 1973 - Section 439 - Regular Bail - Offence under Section 420, 406 IPC. Investigation complete and charge-sheet filed. Custodial interrogation no longer warranted. Bail is the rule and jail is the exception reaffirmed.
headnote_text: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 — S. 439 — Cheating and criminal breach of trust — Pre-trial detention: Charge-sheet filed; applicant entitled to bail with stringent travel conditions.

case_title: Internet Freedom Foundation v. Union of India
party_caption: Internet Freedom Foundation versus Union of India
coram_members_text: N.V. Ramana, R. Subhash Reddy and B.R. Gavai, JJ.
disposition_text: Petition Disposed of with review directions for suspension orders under Telecom Suspension Rules.
indexable_text: CONSTITUTION OF INDIA - Article 19(1)(a) and 19(1)(g) - Right to freedom of speech and expression and right to carry on trade/profession over the medium of Internet is constitutionally protected. Indefinite suspension of telecom services not permissible under law. Proportionality test must be satisfied.
headnote_text: Freedom of Speech — Article 19(1)(a) — Internet access — Indefinite suspension impermissible: State must adhere to principle of proportionality and publish suspension orders.
